$749,000

Old Murray Paris Rd , Puryear, TN 38251(Henry County)

Size: 331 Acres
Type: Farms and Ranches

Farm, PURYEAR, TN

Discover the ultimate blend of natural beauty, recreational opportunity, and development potential with this expansive 331-acre property located just 10 minutes from Paris, TN, and a short drive to Murray, KY and the stunning shores of Kentucky Lake. This versatile tract features a mix of partial pastureland and cutover timber, creating an ideal environment for whitetail deer, wild turkey, and other small game. Whether you're a passionate hunter, nature lover, or investor, this land offers endless possibilities. This is a rare opportunity to purchase a tract of land with this acreage. Call today to schedule YOUR personal tour of the property.
